title: Right Answers, Costly Models: The Efficiency Gap in LLM-based Optimization Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.38884v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optimization modeling formulates real-world decision problems as mathematical programs that solvers can use to find optimal decisions. Large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, but the resulting correct formulations can require substantial time and memory to construct and solve, limiting practical scalability. Therefore, we systematically investigate whether LLMs can identify problem structure from natural-language descriptions and apply suitable optimization modeling techniques to generate mathematical models and solver code that solve the problems correctly and efficiently. To this end, we first curate OptTips, a knowledge base of 50 expert modeling techniques in eight families. Using this knowledge, we develop OptDachshund, a multi-agent framework that transforms problems from existing optimization benchmarks into new tasks for evaluating LLMs' use of modeling techniques. translated_title: 正确答案，昂贵模型：基于大语言模型优化建模中的效率差距
translated_abstract: 优化建模将现实世界的决策问题表述为数学规划，求解器可利用其找到最优决策。大型语言模型（LLM）可以实现这一过程的自动化，但由此得到的正确公式化模型在构建和求解时可能需要大量的时间和内存，限制了实际应用的可扩展性。因此，我们系统地研究了LLM能否从自然语言描述中识别问题结构，并应用合适的优化建模技术，生成既能正确求解又高效的数学模型和求解器代码。为此，我们首先编纂了OptTips——一个涵盖八大类共50种专家建模技术的知识库。借助这些知识，我们开发了OptDachshund，一个多智能体框架，它将现有优化基准测试中的问题转化为新任务，用于评估LLM对建模技术的运用。该框架构建了常规的和专家的数学……
tldr: 该论文提出包含八大类共50种专家建模技术的知识库OptTips和多智能体框架OptDachshund，系统评估LLM能否运用建模技术生成既正确又高效的优化模型与求解器代码。
en_tdlr: Introduces OptTips, a knowledge base of 50 expert modeling techniques across eight families, and OptDachshund, a multi-agent framework, to systematically evaluate whether LLMs can apply modeling techniques to generate both correct and efficient optimization models and solver code.
